_note: Our own data. Getting to a job (DESIGN.md 'Exploring vs. fighting'): jobs are at real places on the region map; close ones you walk to (in your mechs), farther ones need a ride: a dropship (a patron's, or chartered), a ship for anything in space, or a hired vehicle (a crawler, a train, a flatbed). Mechs are carried by dropships and haulers in the setting (Core p.30-31, p.82: printed and deployed where needed; the Orbital Drop reserve, Core p.48). Which hub conflicts mean open war (ambushes on the roads) and the hours each ride takes.

walk.name: on foot, in your mechs
walk.text: It's close: walk out of town in your mechs.

vehicle.name: a hired vehicle
vehicle.text: Too far to walk: a hired crawler carries the squad and its mechs.

dropship.name: a dropship
dropship.text: A dropship takes the squad and its mechs out to the site.

ship.name: a ship
ship.text: It's out in space: a ship carries the squad there.
